result.summary: Updates the Guix time-machine commit to 60f6956aeffa7f30285745bd0ea615e9acfc74f8 and bumps the python-lief lint requirement to 0.17.6. In manifest_gui.scm, it disables test suites for transitive dependencies (python-psutil, python-pytest-xprocess, and python-sh) pulled in by python-lief and nsis-x86_64.
result.problem: Running Guix builds natively on riscv64-linux fails with 'package python-lief@0.17.5 does not support riscv64-linux' because transitive dependency python-msgspec was restricted to x86_64 and aarch64. Furthermore, native riscv64 builds fail tests for several transitive dependencies of python-lief and nsis-x86_64.
evidence: Build failure on RISC-V systems reported in #36232: 'guix shell: error: package python-lief@0.17.5 does not support riscv64-linux'
Upstream Guix commit b35905695a updates python-msgspec and removes the supported-systems restriction
result.changed_since_previous: No functional changes to the diff; commits remain unchanged in scope.
result.card: Updates the Guix time-machine pin and bumps CI python-lief to 0.17.6 to unblock running Guix builds natively on RISC-V systems. It also disables tests in manifest_gui.scm for transitive dependencies (python-psutil, python-pytest-xprocess, and python-sh) that fail when built natively on riscv64. This resolves issue #36232 where python-msgspec prevented python-lief from supporting riscv64-linux.

risk.why: Updating the Guix commit changes the build environment and toolchain packages used to produce reproducible release binaries.
